# Disney’s Mickey & Friends Show Their NFL Team Spirit with New Apparel, Collectibles, and Fan Gear


[Entertainment](https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/entertainment/)


October 29, 2026


3 min. read


As **Disney** and **ESPN** celebrate “[We’re Going to the Super Bowl LXI](https://espnpressroom.com/press-release/espn-unveils-the-year-of-the-super-bowl-a-landmark-yearlong-celebration-building-toward-espns-first-super-bowl-production-in-february-2027/) ,” **Mickey & Friends** are teaming up with the **NFL** to kick off a season-long lineup of new products that give fans more ways to show their fandom. Whether gearing up for **Super Bowl LXI** in **Los Angeles** or celebrating a favorite NFL team, fans can look forward to new apparel, collectibles, accessories, and fan gear. The collections will roll out throughout the season with select products available across[NFLShop.com](https://www.nflshop.com/) ,[Fanatics.com](https://www.fanatics.com/) ,[DisneyStore.com](https://www.disneystore.com/) ,


and select retailers nationwide.


“Sports is a growing area for Disney Consumer Products, reaching highly engaged audiences and sitting at the center of culture,” said **Paul Gitter** , executive vice president of global licensing at Disney Consumer Products. “As ESPN brings fans along the road to Super Bowl LXI, these products give them another way to connect with the teams, athletes and stories they love, while Mickey & Friends bring a uniquely Disney expression to the heart of NFL culture.”


“The NFL and Disney are embarking on one of the most exciting chapters in our shared history,” said **Casey Collins** , senior vice president of consumer products and licensing at the NFL. “With new products already in the market and more to come in the lead up to Super Bowl LXI on Disney’s networks and platforms, there is no better time to be a fan of these two iconic brands.”


Starting today, fans can shop new products from leading NFL licensees with offerings including apparel, collectibles, accessories, and fan gear designed for game day and beyond.


## Gear Up for Super Bowl LXI


- **[Disney | Champion](https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/news/champion-nfl-collection-fanatics-fest/) :** Mickey & Friends hit the road to Los Angeles with t-shirts and crewnecks celebrating Super Bowl LXI, available in adult and youth sizing.


- **Disney Pinnacle by Dapper Labs:** Collect Mickey & Friends Super Bowl LXI digital pins from[Disney Pinnacle by Dapper Labs](https://disneypinnacle.com/MickeyAndFriendsNFL) .


## Celebrate Your Favorite NFL Team


- **Disney | FOCO:** Fans can rep their favorite team alongside Mickey & Friends with plush, clip-on plush, bobbleheads, figurines, and clear stadium bags, starting today on[FOCO.com](https://www.foco.com/) .


The lineup will continue to grow throughout the season, with additional **Disney x NFL** product drops inspired by Mickey & Friends from **Crocs** , **Just Play** , **New Era** , **WinCraft** , and more from **Champion** , giving fans even more ways to celebrate their favorite teams and the road to Super Bowl LXI.


Through the iconic “ **Disney’s Super Bowl What’s Next** ’’ campaign, celebrating its **40th anniversary** this season, Disney has long been part of football’s biggest moments. This year marks another milestone, as the Super Bowl airs on ESPN and **ABC** and[streams on Disney+](https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/news/super-bowl-disney-plus/) for the first time, followed by the traditional championship celebration at Disneyland Resort.


Now, Mickey & Friends are bringing that connection to fans all season long with new looks in the official team colors of all 32 NFL teams, plus Super Bowl LXI. Whether cheering from the stands, gathering with family and friends on gameday or celebrating a favorite team, fans can share in the excitement with Mickey & Friends and the NFL throughout the season.
